$comment: Device registry for the wallet compatibility matrix. See README.md.

swiyu.notes: Locks on every backgrounding, so each delivery needs a re-login and a slow one lets the request expire. Asks again mid-flow before releasing a presentation. Rejects a cast whose did:webvh log or DID document is malformed, before any consent screen. Never serve it key_attestations_required: it then demands a key attestation from attestations.trust-infra.swiyu.admin.ch that a test device cannot obtain.

inji.notes: Drops a VIEW intent when already idle at home, so force-stop before delivering. Its biometric prompt sometimes stops responding to taps; force-stop and retry. Skips the consent screen entirely for an issuer host it has already trusted.

authbound.notes: EUDI codebase on a build that pins eudi-lib-android-wallet-core 0.28.1. Lists every credential matching a query with no way to choose and submits all of them, so a query matching two held credentials is rejected by the verifier.

eudi.notes: Pins eudi-lib-android-wallet-core 0.29.0, which requires key_attestations_required in the advertised jwt proof type. Its accept header is identical to swiyu's, so the server cannot serve one without the other; this needs a wallet-side fix, not a server accommodation.

procivis.notes: Discards the verifier DID unless the request arrives as a DID identifier, then queries the resolver with an empty did and renders COULD NOT VERIFY while leaving Share enabled. Fetches a credential as soon as an offer resolves, before any verdict exists, so the issuer marks the session Completed even when the wallet refuses.

sphereon.notes: Identifies a verifier by its did:web alias, which carries no trust evaluation, so verifier requests fall back to a federation warning. The Maybe later button on the biometrics step has malformed bounds on a 1080x2412 screen and cannot be tapped.

talao.notes: Only acts on the link at cold start; delivered while running it logs onAppLink and drops it. Rejects the dc+sd-jwt format the casts issue.

paradym.skip: Unlocks only through a biometric prompt with no PIN fallback, even when biometrics is deferred during onboarding. Needs a finger on the sensor.

bcwallet.notes: AnonCreds and DIDComm only; declares no OpenID4VC schemes. Accepts the OOB link and increments its notification badge, but the offer row never renders in the list.

nl-wallet.skip: Distinguishes a scanned QR from a link: the scan path sets a cross-device session type that the verifier request is checked against, so a link delivery is rejected. Needs a real optical scan.

wwwallet.skip: Browser wallet at wwwallet.playground.testnet.verana.network; needs a passkey sign-in.

hologram.skip: Store build resolves Q1 only; the Q2/Q3 work is unreleased upstream.
